result.stdout:
deflake — finds out why a test is flaky

Usage:
  deflake investigate <project|solution> [options]
  deflake repro <report.json>
  deflake explain <VERDICT-ID>
  deflake --help | -h | help
  deflake --version | -v

Investigate command options:
  --test <FQN>              Test to investigate (may be repeated)
  --from-trx <file>         Read failures from a TRX file
  --runs <n>                Run count before adaptive runs (default: 20)
  --max-runs <n>            Maximum runs per condition (default: same as --runs)
  --timeout <minutes>       Time budget for investigation (default: 60)
  --framework <tfm>         Target framework moniker (e.g. net8.0)
  --configuration <c>       Build configuration (default: Debug)
  --no-build                Do not rebuild before testing
  --report <dir>            Write reports to directory instead of console
  --format text|markdown|json  Output format (default: text)
  --record-replay           Record TimeProvider/Random during isolation run,
                            then replay deterministically (requires Deflake.Runtime)
